Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Record Class ListingFilter

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.hkust.marketplace.services.ListingFilter
Record Components:
status - one listing status, or null for all
reportedOnly - true to show only listings that have at least one report
category - one category, or null for all
type - one listing type, or null for all
seller - text matched against the seller's username or full name, ignoring case; null or blank for all
fromDate - first posted day, inclusive, or null
toDate - last posted day, inclusive, or null
public record ListingFilter(ListingStatus status, boolean reportedOnly, Category category, ListingType type, String seller, LocalDate fromDate, LocalDate toDate) extends Record
The filter options of the admin's listing list (Manage Marketplace Listings, step 2). A null field (or false for reportedOnly) means "no filter on this". "Reported" is not a listing status, so it is its own flag; with a status set, both must match.
